lines.en: : Okay. I’ll come over.
lines.zh: : 好吧。我过去。

lines.en: : But I’m not cleaning anything.
lines.zh: : 但我可不帮忙打扫。

lines.en: : Awe, rats. I had an apron picked out for you and everything.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，真可惜。我连围裙都替你挑好了呢。

lines.en: : That is mildly terrifying, but I appreciate the sentiment.
lines.zh: : 这有点吓人，不过我心领了。

lines.en: scene black
Miu’s house isn’t all that far from the dock.
lines.zh: Miu 家离码头不算太远。

lines.en: I limp the whole way there.
lines.zh: 我一瘸一拐地走完了全程。

lines.en: Miu notices and tries to help me, but I dismiss her.
lines.zh: Miu 注意到了，想来扶我，但我谢绝了。

lines.en: Pain is only a pulse if you just stop feeling it.
lines.zh: 只要你不再去感受它，疼痛就只是一阵脉动。

lines.en: scene traditional_lights
: I’m home!
lines.zh: : 我回来了！

lines.en: Miu announces her arrival the same way she would if the house were filled with people.
lines.zh: Miu 宣告自己到家的方式，就跟这栋房子里

lines.en: She leaves her shoes in the entryway.
lines.zh: 她把鞋脱在玄关。

lines.en: I do the same.
lines.zh: 我也照样做了。

lines.en: It’s an old, traditional Japanese building.
lines.zh: 这是一栋古老的传统日式建筑。

lines.en: I wonder how long her family has owned it for?
lines.zh: 我在想，她家拥有它多久了？

lines.en: If you haven’t figured it out by now, Miu comes from a wealthy family.
lines.zh: 要是你到现在还没看出来 —— Miu 出身于一个富裕的

lines.en: She grew up sheltered for the most part- not attending public school until she moved here last year.
lines.zh: 她基本上是娇生惯养长大的 —— 没上过公立学校，

lines.en: I’ve heard stories in the past about how her father was opposed to it, and how she had to pretty much beg her mom to reason with him."
lines.zh: 我以前听说过，她父亲曾经反对

lines.en: I’m sure it was a long and arduous process.
lines.zh: 我敢说，那是个漫长而艰难的过程。

lines.en: But we’re here now, aren't we?
lines.zh: 但现在我们不是已经在这里了吗？

lines.en: That’s all that matters.
lines.zh: 这才是唯一重要的事。

lines.en: show miu_surprised
: Senpai, the bath is just around the corner.
lines.zh: : 学长，浴室就在拐角那边。

lines.en: : You know how real ones work, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道真正的浴室怎么用吧？

lines.en: : Just what kind of person do you think I am?
lines.zh: : 你把我当成什么人了？

lines.en: show miu_catsmile
: One that bathes in the wild like some sort of animal.
lines.zh: : 当成会像野兽一样在野外洗澡的人。

lines.en: show miu_surprised
: Now, go. I’ll put some tea on and lay out a futon.
lines.zh: : 好了，去吧。我去烧点茶，再把被褥铺好。

lines.en: : It’ll be ready by the time you get out.
lines.zh: : 等你出来的时候就都准备好了。

lines.en: I nod at her and head for the bathroom.
lines.zh: 我朝她点点头，走向浴室。

lines.en: scene black
scene traditional_lights
show miu_surprised
Miu is sitting at the coffee table with a small pot of tea when I get back.
lines.zh: Miu 正坐在茶几旁，旁边放着一小壶茶，就在这时

lines.en: : Oh, senpai. Finished already?
lines.zh: : 哦，学长。已经洗好了？

lines.en: : It appears that way.
lines.zh: : 看起来是这样。

lines.en: : I feel kind of weird putting the same clothes back on after a bath, though.
lines.zh: : 洗完澡又把同一套衣服穿回去，感觉怪怪的。

lines.en: show miu_catsmile
: You could always take them off. I wouldn’t mind~
lines.zh: : 你也可以不穿啊。我不介意哦~

lines.en: : Then why did you mind thirty minutes ago at the lake?
lines.zh: : 那三十分钟前在湖边，你为什么又介意了？

lines.en: show miu_normal
: Context, duh.
lines.zh: : 那得看场合啊，笨。

lines.en: : Isn’t the situation now like ten times more romantic than the one from before?
lines.zh: : 现在的气氛不是比刚才浪漫十倍吗？

lines.en: She does have a point.
lines.zh: 她说得确实有道理。

lines.en: I doubt anything is going to happen, though,
lines.zh: 不过我怀疑不会发生什么。

lines.en: I’m pretty sure if I actually came out of the bathroom naked, Miu would have ran away and crashed into a dresser or something."
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，要是我真的光着身子从浴室出去，Miu

lines.en: She’s not ready for a lover yet.
lines.zh: 她还没有准备好交恋人。

lines.en: She needs to worry about herself first.
lines.zh: 她得先顾好她自己。

lines.en: Plus, even I know I’m not the best candidate for something like that.
lines.zh: 再说，连我自己都清楚，我不是做这种事的合适人选。

lines.en: But it doesn’t hurt to pretend like I am sometimes.
lines.zh: 不过偶尔装装样子也没什么损失。

lines.en: : Sorry kouhai, but I think I'll keep my clothes on tonight.
lines.zh: : 抱歉啊学妹，不过今晚我还是穿着衣服吧。

lines.en: : The mood still seems a little off, don't you think?
lines.zh: : 气氛感觉还是有点不对劲，你不觉得吗？

lines.en: show miu_pout
: Boo…
show miu_catsmile
: But I guess that’s fine.
lines.zh: : 不过我想也没关系。

lines.en: : There’s always next time, right?
lines.zh: : 总有下次的，对吧？

lines.en: : There’s always next time.
lines.zh: : 总有下次。

lines.en: Miu gets up from the table and turns the lights off.
lines.zh: Miu 从桌边站起身，关掉了灯。

lines.en: scene traditional_night
: Goodnight, senpai.
lines.zh: : 晚安，学长。

lines.en: : Don’t forget to drink your tea before it gets cold.
lines.zh: : 别忘了在茶凉之前把它喝掉。

lines.en: : Thanks, Miu.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Miu。

lines.en: : Goodnight.
lines.zh: : 晚安。

lines.en: scene black
I couldn’t sleep at all that night.
lines.zh: 那天夜里我完全睡不着。

lines.en: I could hear Miu crying from the other side of the house.
lines.zh: 我能听见 Miu 在房子另一头哭泣。

lines.en: I didn’t have the courage to go to her room and ask her what was wrong.
lines.zh: 我没有勇气去她的房间，问她到底怎么了。

lines.en: I just went home instead.
lines.zh: 我只是径直回家了。

lines.en: I’m sorry.
lines.zh: 对不起。
